title: Evaluating the Robustness of Proof Autoformalization in Lean 4
abstract: arXiv:2606.14867v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Proof autoformalization aims to translate a mathematical informal proof in natural language into a formal proof in a formal language such as Lean 4. Existing LLM-based models for proof autoformalization are typically evaluated only on well-formed informal proofs from curated datasets. We argue that a robust proof autoformalizer must remain faithful even for informal proofs that diverge from these idealized ones, and we present the first study on the robustness of proof autoformalization models. We formulate two categories of perturbations: a global perturbation paraphrases the informal theorem-proof pair in a different style, under which the formalization should remain consistent; a local perturbation alters a value, symbol, or proof step, possibly in a counterfactual way, and a robust formalization should faithfully reflect the perturbation rather than reverting to the original or inferring a different one on its own. translated_abstract: 证明自动形式化旨在将自然语言描述的非形式化数学证明翻译成形式语言（如 Lean 4）中的形式化证明。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的证明自动形式化模型通常仅在来自精选数据集的格式良好的非形式化证明上进行评估。我们认为，一个鲁棒的证明自动形式化器即使面对偏离这些理想化证明的非形式化证明也必须保持忠实性，并据此开展了首个关于证明自动形式化模型鲁棒性的研究。我们定义了两类扰动：全局扰动以不同风格对非形式化的定理-证明对进行改写，在此扰动下形式化结果应保持一致；局部扰动以可能反事实的方式改变某个数值、符号或证明步骤，而鲁棒的形式化结果应忠实地反映该扰动，而不是回退到原始内容或自行推断出不同的内容。我们构建了……
tldr: 本文首次研究了证明自动形式化模型的鲁棒性，提出全局改写扰动与局部（可能反事实的）修改扰动两类测试方法，以检验模型在偏离理想化数据集的非形式化证明上能否保持忠实。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first study on the robustness of proof autoformalization models, introducing global paraphrase perturbations and local (possibly counterfactual) modifications to test whether models remain faithful on informal proofs that diverge from idealized curated datasets.
